integrity_notes: Full finite support partition and exact integer certificates are included; all relevant source dates and earlier theorems are described without claiming independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for 16 indexed cyclic binary symbols and complete three-gram multiplicities; neither an all-length extremal theorem nor a cyclic-necklace count.
The size 1296 of the uniform multi-de Bruijn class was already established by prior enumeration; the unique global maximization and runner-up comparison are the contribution.
Possible unindexed finite tables could contain an equivalent extremal statistic; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Unique modal binary cyclic three-gram profile at length sixteen
